# Healthcare ML Genetic Risk Predictor

> A real-time genetic risk prediction system built with Quarkus WebSockets, deployed on Azure Red Hat OpenShift with event-driven architecture and scale-to-zero capabilities. The system processes genetic data in real-time using WebSocket connections, Kafka event streaming, and machine learning inference, designed for cost-effective deployment on OpenShift with comprehensive monitoring and HIPAA-compliant security. Features multi-tier autoscaling with KEDA for different workload types: normal mode (pod scaling), big data mode (memory-intensive), and node scale mode (cluster autoscaler integration).

This is a sophisticated healthcare ML application that demonstrates enterprise-grade genetic sequence processing with real-time scaling capabilities. The system uses an event-driven microservices architecture where genetic sequences are submitted via WebSocket connections, processed through Kafka topics, annotated using the Ensembl VEP API, and results are returned in real-time. The architecture supports three distinct scaling modes based on sequence size and complexity, enabling cost optimization through scale-to-zero capabilities.

The project showcases modern cloud-native development patterns including reactive programming with Quarkus, event streaming with Kafka, CloudEvents for message standardization, and comprehensive observability with Prometheus metrics. It includes extensive documentation following the Diátaxis framework, comprehensive deployment automation, and production-ready security configurations for healthcare compliance.

Key technical concepts include genetic variant annotation (VEP), HGVS notation, multi-tier autoscaling strategies, cost attribution and chargeback models, and event-driven architecture patterns. The system integrates with Red Hat OpenShift AI for machine learning model serving and includes Jupyter notebooks for interactive genetic analysis and demonstration purposes.

## Application Services

quarkus-websocket-service/: Main WebSocket service built with Quarkus for real-time genetic data processing and session management
quarkus-websocket-service/src/main/java/: Java source code for WebSocket endpoints, Kafka integration, and reactive messaging
quarkus-websocket-service/pom.xml: Maven configuration with Quarkus 3.8.6, WebSockets, Kafka reactive messaging, and CloudEvents dependencies
vep-service/: VEP (Variant Effect Predictor) annotation service for genetic variant processing
vep-service/src/main/java/: Java source code for VEP API integration, Kafka message processing, and annotation logic
vep-service/pom.xml: Maven configuration for VEP service with REST client, Kafka messaging, and caching capabilities

## Infrastructure & Deployment

k8s/: Complete OpenShift/Kubernetes deployment manifests using Kustomize
k8s/base/: Base Kustomize resources including operators, infrastructure, applications, and eventing configurations
k8s/base/operators/: Operator subscriptions for AMQ Streams, OpenShift Serverless, KEDA, and OpenShift AI
k8s/base/infrastructure/: Kafka cluster, namespace, and infrastructure component definitions
k8s/base/applications/: Application deployments for Quarkus WebSocket service and VEP service with comprehensive configurations
k8s/base/eventing/: KEDA ScaledObjects for event-driven autoscaling with different scaling modes and triggers
k8s/overlays/: Environment-specific configurations for dev, staging, and prod with resource limits and scaling parameters
k8s/components/: Reusable components including cost labels and security contexts for HIPAA compliance

scripts/generate-genetic-sequence.js: Genetic sequence generation utility for testing and demonstration purposes

## Machine Learning & Analysis

notebooks/genetic-analysis/02_kafka_realtime_processing.ipynb: Real-time Kafka integration for genetic data processing and KEDA scaling demonstrations

notebooks/genetic-analysis/sample_genetic_data.csv: Sample genetic sequence data with risk scores and sequence metrics
